## Merge 'trie refresh' into 'trie sync --graph-only' (hard removal) and fix the… — 2026-07-29 (parent a926bd7632ca)

**Merged 'trie refresh' into 'trie sync --graph-only', made freshness always report both graph and prose staleness, added stale-only sync --file, class-covers-methods gate semantics, apply-time coverage feedback, improved grep for non-tty consumers, and a version-skew warning on gate.**

`trie refresh` is hard-removed; its behaviour lives under `trie sync --graph-only` (and `--before-turn`/`--after-turn`, which imply `--graph-only`). Turn hooks now run `trie sync --graph-only --after-turn`. The `--graph-only` flag rejects every LLM-mode flag (`--file`, `--budget`, `--all`, `--model`) explicitly; a turn hook is never one dropped flag away from LLM spend.

`FreshnessResult` drops the `incremental` field and populates `stale_files` from the pending set on every outcome, including `unchanged`. `_report_freshness` always emits two clauses — graph state and prose state — so the CLI never claims 'already fresh' while the pre-commit gate would fail.

`sync --file` is now stale-only by default: it computes stale qnames via the same classifier as the gate and passes `symbols_to_regen`; `--force` restores full-rewrite semantics. A fully-fresh file exits without constructing a client.

`intent_gate.evaluate` gains class-covers-methods semantics via `_parent_qname`: a touched method is covered when its owning class has a note. `record_intent` now attaches an `uncovered` key to the envelope and adjusts `next` at apply time.

`gate_cmd` runs `_warn_on_version_skew` as step 0, warning with the reinstall command when the project's `pyproject.toml` declares `trie` at a different version than the running binary.

`TrieTools.grep` fills partial name hits with prose/body-matched `related` candidates (excluding already-hit qnames) and caps fallback by the request's own limit. `_render_grep` emits plain untruncated `<qname>  <kind>  <file:line>` records to non-tty consumers. `Mcp.grep_fallback_match_limit` default drops from 30 to 8.
